message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.flares: The mark on its brow flares as it dies. It does not go out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.not_over: %s falls. You know it isn't over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.learned.shot: %s has learned to take your shots.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.learned.blun: %s shrugs off your blows; it's learned them.
news.jaymoskingdoms.bane.climbed: %1$s, who hunts %2$s, is said to have climbed to rank %3$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.born: Something you buried today will not stay down. It has a name now: %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.kille: %1$s. The grave was kind to you. I was not. Again.
Back from the dark, %1$s? I keep the dark. I'll send you back.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.slain: You put me in the ground, %1$s. The ground gave me back. It always will.
Your blade knew my heart, %1$s. I have none left to find.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.arrives.again: %1$s. I have walked every night since we last met.
No rest for either of us, %1$s. I've seen to that.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.leaves.0: The night is long. I can wait.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.not_yours.0: Not by your hand. Tell %s I'll be waiting.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.not_yours.1: You are not the one I rose for. Go home, and tell %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.downed.0: Kneel, %1$s. You'll grow used to it.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.downed.1: Down, %1$s. Lie with my dead a while.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.0: %1$s. I wore your fall like a new mail coat. Rank %3$s now. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.1: They call me rank %3$s since you knelt, %1$s. The dead keep count. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.note.2: A token for you, %1$s: my blade, sharper by your blood. %2$s, rank %3$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.born: Word comes that a dead outlaw has a new name, and is spending yours. They call him %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.kill: %1$s! Every tavern on the road drinks to the day I killed you. Let's give them another.
Look who's walking again. %1$s, you're the best thing that ever happened to me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.slai: You left me for dead, %1$s. Bad habit. I came back richer.
%1$s! Remember me? You should. You made me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.arrives.agai: %1$s. Every man here follows me because of you. Let's remind them why.
My favourite name, %1$s. I wear it everywhere.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.leaves.0: Another day, friend. I've a reputation to keep.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.leaves.1: Lads, we're done. Let the hero catch their breath.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.not_yours.0: Not you. %s gets the honour, nobody else.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.not_yours.1: You'd steal %s's glory? I like you. Still no.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.downed.0: That's the one I'll tell, %1$s! On your knees!
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.downed.1: Stay down, %1$s. The lads need a story.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.0: Dear %1$s, your fall bought me a new axe and three more men. Rank %3$s. Your friend, %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.1: %1$s, the taverns sing it now: %2$s, rank %3$s, the one who beat you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.note.2: %1$s: thank you. Nobody climbs like I climb on your name. Rank %3$s. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.born: Something below has taken the one you finished. It is sworn to you now, in the worst way. It calls itself %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.arrives.killed: Your soul smelled sweet the last time, %1$s. I want the rest.
%1$s. The fire remembers you. So do I.
You burned out my first life, %1$s. The pit gave me a hotter one.
%1$s! You sent me down. I came back with friends.
Every coal in the pit carries your name, %1$s.
%1$s. Our pact isn't done until one of us is ash.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.leaves.0: The pit calls. It always calls me back to you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.leaves.1: Burn a while longer, little one.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.not_yours.0: Your soul isn't the one I was promised. %s's is.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.not_yours.1: Out of my way. I am sworn to %s alone.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.downed.0: Down in the cinders, %1$s, where you belong.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.0: %1$s, your fall fed the fire. I am rank %3$s now. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.1: A scorched page for %1$s: rank %3$s, and hungrier. %2$s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.note.2: %1$s. Each time you fall I grow. Rank %3$s. Count them. %2$s.
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_q_bane: What marks can end your master?
bane.jaymoskingdoms.question.none.1: I don't know any marks. I swear it.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.question.told.0: The %2$s mark. That's all I was ever told, %1$s, I swear.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.question.told.1: All right! %2$s. It's one of them. That's all I have.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.question.placed.0: The %2$s mark, %1$s. It goes %3$s. Please, that's all I know.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.question.placed.1: Stop! %2$s, cut %3$s. Now let me go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.no_bane: You've no Bane to carve marks against.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.ground_off: You grind the marks off the blade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.wrong: The marks fail. %s laughs. You learn which of them were wrong.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.ended: %s is ended. Its weapon is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.sworn: %s kneels, and is sworn to you.
news.jaymoskingdoms.bane.ended: %1$s, who hunted %2$s, is dead at last, ended by %2$s's own hand.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.screen.title: Bane Marks
bane.jaymoskingdoms.screen.sub: Three of eight, in order, end %s.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.screen.how: Finish it with this blade (downed, or its head off).
bane.jaymoskingdoms.screen.swear: Sneak as you finish it to swear it to you instead.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.talk.jaymo: You found my marks, %s. Then I'm yours. I keep my word as I kept my hate.
Spared, by you? Fine, %s. Point me at someone worse.
So it ends with a leash, %s. Lead on.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.laughs.0: Wrong, all wrong! The grave keeps its secrets.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.laughs.1: Ha! Those marks open no tomb of mine.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.laughs.0: Ha! Wrong marks, friend! Better luck next time.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.laughs.1: That tickled. Who sold you those marks?
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.men.0: %2$s wants a word with you, %1$s. Several, actually.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.laughs.0: Wrong! The pact holds, and I burn brighter.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.laughs.1: Those marks are ash in your hands.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.hold.0: %1$s has raised a keep of grave-stone %2$s. The dead keep its walls. It waits for you there.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.hold.1: A tomb-keep stands %2$s now, and %1$s sits in it like a king in his barrow. Come, it says.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.hold.0: %1$s has built himself a fort %2$s, logs and all, paid for with your name. Drop in, he writes.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.hold.1: Word is %1$s has a stockade %2$s now, and men enough to hold it. He's expecting you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.hold.0: %1$s has raised a hold of hell-brick %2$s. The air there tastes of ash. It waits.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.hold.1: A black keep has risen %2$s. %1$s burns in its heart, and calls your name.
news.jaymoskingdoms.bane.rebuilt: %s has rebuilt the walls of its hold.
news.jaymoskingdoms.bane.hold_fell: The hold of %1$s has been stormed by %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.siege: Your banner lays siege to %s's hold. Keep its band away from it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.siege.torn: The banner is down. The siege is broken.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.siege.bar.co: Storming the hold of %s (its band is at the banner)
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.hold_fell: The walls are broken. %s can be ended now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bane.warded: Its walls ward %s. Storm its hold first: plant a banner near its heart and hold it.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.warded.0: These walls are older than your line. You cannot end me here.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.warded.1: My keep holds me up. Break it first, if you can.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.warded.0: Not in my own house, friend. Not while my walls stand.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.warded.1: Ha! You'll have to take the fort before you take me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.warded.0: This is my hearth. It burns for me, not you.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.warded.1: My fire is fed from these stones. Break them, if you can.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.hold_falls.0: My walls! You will pay for every stone.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.knight.hold_falls.1: The keep is broken. Then we finish this in the open.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.hold_falls.0: My fort! Do you know what that cost me?
bane.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.hold_falls.1: Fine. No walls. Just you and me.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.hold_falls.0: My hearth is cold! You will burn for that.
bane.jaymoskingdoms.demon.hold_falls.1: The fire is out. Mine is not.
